routingInfo: <title>Routing logic: </title>Every agent call is classified by data sensitivity (public → internal → confidential → privileged). The Gateway selects the active, healthy provider with the lowest priority that supports the required level or higher. Privileged data (legal professional privilege) is routed exclusively to on-prem providers.
